definitions.gloss: marine products; seafood products; aquatic products
definitions.explanation: Products obtained from oceans, rivers, and aquaculture, including fish, shellfish, seaweed, and other aquatic organisms. Used in trade, industry, and government contexts rather than everyday cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水産物|すいさんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{消費量|しょうひりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Japan has high consumption of marine products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な{水産物|すいさんぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Fresh marine products are lined up at the market.

examples.japanese: {水産物|すいさんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}→強化：00260_kyouka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{仕入|しい}れ→仕入れる：11430_shiireru⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}している→上昇する：21681_joushousuru⟧。
examples.english: Since import regulations on marine products were tightened, procurement prices have risen.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat formal term used in trade, government policy, and industry contexts. In everyday conversation, ⟦{海産物|かいさんぶつ}→海産物：13394_kaisanbutsu⟧ (marine products) or simply ⟦{魚介類|ぎょかいるい}→魚介類：23435_gyokairui⟧ (seafood) is more common. {水産物|すいさんぶつ} covers both ocean and freshwater products.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水産物|すいさんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{輸出入|ゆしゅつにゅう} (import and export of marine products)
- {水産物|すいさんぶつ}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧ (marine product processing)
- {水産物|すいさんぶつ}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧ (marine products market)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{海産物|かいさんぶつ}→海産物：13394_kaisanbutsu⟧: marine products — specifically from the sea, not freshwater
- ⟦{魚介類|ぎょかいるい}→魚介類：23435_gyokairui⟧: seafood — the everyday term for fish and shellfish
- ⟦{水産業|すいさんぎょう}→水産業：15919_suisangyou⟧: fishing industry — the industry that produces marine products
